name: Analyze Western Blot
description: Performs densitometric analysis of Western blot images to quantify relative protein expression.
detailed_description: Performs densitometric analysis of Western blot images to quantify relative protein expression.
when_to_use: When you need analyze western blot analysis

parameters.blot_image_path: [Required] Path to the Western blot image file (str)
parameters.target_bands: [Required] List of dictionaries containing information about target protein bands, each with 'name' and 'roi' (region of interest as [x, y, width, height]) (list of dict)
parameters.loading_control_band: [Required] Dictionary with 'name' and 'roi' for the loading control protein (e.g., β-actin, GAPDH) (dict)
parameters.antibody_info: [Required] Dictionary containing information about antibodies used with 'primary' and 'secondary' keys (dict)
